facts.text: Snow left Sawmill (10,200 ft) 12 days earlier this year than the midpoint of two of the three earlier seasons on file (2024 and 2025).

evidence.name: Sawmill
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: May 14 (2024), May 12 (2025); 2023: readings jump by more than snow can

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the second highest of three of the four seasons on file (2024 to 2026) at Blackcap Basin (10,180 ft) and the lowest at Sawmill (10,200 ft).

evidence.name: Blackcap Basin
evidence.detail: 20.6 in on May 1; earlier seasons: 43.5 in (2024), 5.8 in (2025)

evidence.name: Sawmill
evidence.detail: 6.3 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 14.6 in (2024), 14.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 14 and July 8, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.
